PROFESSIONAL EDUCATION APP PROMPT – TEST BANK

Create a professional, modern, mobile-friendly education application named TEST BANK exclusively for Class 9 students.

1. App Details

- App Name: TEST BANK
- Target Class: Class 9 only
- Board: All Indian Education Boards
- Language: Hindi and English
- Design: Professional, modern and attractive
- Theme: Blue, white and dark mode
- Platform: Android and mobile-friendly web app

2. Subjects and Questions

Add 100 MCQ questions for EACH subject:

1. Mathematics – 100 Questions
2. Science – 100 Questions
3. Physics – 100 Questions
4. Chemistry – 100 Questions
5. Biology – 100 Questions
6. Social Science – 100 Questions
7. History – 100 Questions
8. Geography – 100 Questions
9. Political Science – 100 Questions
10. Economics – 100 Questions
11. English – 100 Questions
12. Hindi – 100 Questions
13. Urdu – 100 Questions
14. Sanskrit – 100 Questions
15. General Knowledge – 100 Questions

Total: 1,500 MCQ Questions.

Important: Avoid duplicate questions. Follow the Class 9 syllabus and organize questions chapter-wise.

3. MCQ Test System

- Every question must have 4 options: A, B, C, D.
- Only one correct answer.
- Show correct answers after submission.
- Show explanations for answers.
- Next and Previous buttons.
- Question navigation.
- Countdown timer.
- Submit Test button.
- Automatic score calculation.
- Negative marking option.

4. Results System

After completing a test, display:

- Total Questions
- Correct Answers
- Wrong Answers
- Unattempted Questions
- Total Marks
- Percentage
- Performance report

5. Additional Features

- Subject-wise tests
- Chapter-wise tests
- Random MCQ practice
- Daily practice test
- Mock examination
- Previous test history
- Bookmark important questions
- Search questions
- Hindi and English language selection
- Dark mode
- Offline question access where supported

6. Admin Panel

Create an admin panel where the administrator can:

- Add new questions
- Edit questions
- Delete questions
- Add new subjects
- Upload question banks
- Update correct answers
- Add explanations
- Update app content

7. Home Screen

Create an attractive home screen with:

- TEST BANK Logo
- Welcome to TEST BANK
- Class 9
- All Subjects
- Start Practice
- Mock Test
- Daily Quiz
- My Results
- Settings

8. Important Technical Requirements

- Build a fully functional application, not just a UI demo.
- Save test results and user progress.
- Use a database for storing questions.
- Make the app responsive on Android phones.
- Keep the app lightweight and fast.
- Do not use fake buttons or placeholder questions.
- Include all 1,500 properly written questions.
- Organize the project so questions can be updated later.
- Provide a working preview and a downloadable Android APK if supported.

FINAL GOAL: Build TEST BANK as a complete Class 9 MCQ examination application with 15 subjects, 100 unique questions per subject, 4 options per question, correct answers, explanations and a complete examination system.
